summary: Assign planner to define a bounded research question targeting a specific benchmark comparing dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token budgets.
body: The previous research loop failed to produce empirical evidence comparing dynamic consolidation policies against simple baselines (e.g., append-only Markdown) under identical token constraints. Sources described methods but lacked controlled comparisons. Proceed to define a new bounded question targeting a reproducible benchmark (e.g., LongMemEval or MemoryAgentBench) that explicitly matches token budgets and compares success rates/hallucination rates. Limit to 4 sources. Do not implement.
